scope: Actual visual inspection of all four revised F2 original PNGs and all four rendered PDF pages; no source or original result modifications.

plates.name: F2_cases_01

viewed.inspection: Actually viewed full-resolution original PNG through view_image(detail=original)
Actually viewed full-page 130 dpi Poppler PDF rendering through view_image(detail=original)

source_pdf.inspection: PDF successfully rendered independently by collection reviewer; rendered pixels actually reviewed here

findings: Image, original union truth, PaDiM and PatchCore column order is consistent in every row.
Column titles and fixed heatmap ranges are legible and separated from image panels.
All four three-line case captions remain readable and clear of adjacent image rows and titles.
The final explanatory note is fully inside the page and does not overlap the last case caption.
No observed clipping, label collision, misplaced truth outline, or missing panel in either PNG or rendered PDF.

known_display_rounding_note.observation: PatchCore native score and threshold both display as 1.49 while the decision is anomaly.
known_display_rounding_note.reason: This annotation is unchanged from the accepted result. The page note explicitly states that numbers are rounded for display and full precision is in source data. Independent data acceptance verifies the full-precision decision.

limits: This visual review checks presentation and visible correspondence only; exact row hashes, selected-case asset bytes and model decision arithmetic are verified by the independent data audit.
The inspected PDFs were rendered at 130 dpi for visual review; editable text and actual glyph sizes are checked separately.
Different LOCO image aspect ratios are preserved, so panel heights differ between juice-bottle and screw-bag rows as permitted by the image-plate alignment policy.
